fidelity_aggregation: 93 frame distances to a video mean; both seeds to a prompt mean; prompts equally weighted. Complete registered means remain null when a prompt is missing.
speed_aggregation: SUM_BASELINE_SECONDS_DIVIDED_BY_SUM_CANDIDATE_SECONDS on identical paired complete two-seed prompt groups; report all per-seed values and group membership.
comparison_choices: Freeze from N05/N06 development before final outputs; no per-test prompt winner or method tuning.
missing_data: Preserve every original status; complete registered and available paired cohorts are separate; never zero-impute or replace a rejected seed.
zero_reference_LPIPS: Absolute difference retained, relative percentage and its CI undefined; no epsilon floor.
interval_interpretation: Descriptive prompt-grouped uncertainty, not evidence of recording/session independence or a multiple-comparison-corrected significance claim.
